steps.label: Re-run the failover test

caption: The same mechanism that joined BrennanERP -- run again, now, for the one that was missed.

code:
$allDbs = Get-DbaDatabase -SqlInstance SQLDBA01
$agDbs  = Get-DbaAgDatabase -SqlInstance SQLDBA01 `
            -AvailabilityGroup BrennanAG

$unprotected = $allDbs | Where-Object {
  $_.Name -notin $agDbs.DatabaseName
}
# alert nightly if anything comes back here
caption: A recurring check so a database can exist without AG protection for at most a day, never silently.
